title: UNITER: UNiversal Image-TExt Representation Learning
layout_note: One large grey rounded 'UNITER Model' box with a Transformer drawn as a dense node-link mesh over a row of image-region and word inputs; zoom callouts at the top-left (Image Embedder) and top-right (Text Embedder) connect to the inputs by dashed lines; three wide gradient arrows fan down to three small UNITER boxes, one per pre-training task.
grouping: The main model is one dark-grey rounded container; the two embedders are framed white callout boxes with pale yellow (image) or pale green (text) interiors; each pre-training task is a grey bar titled 'UNITER' with its task name in bold beneath.
shapes_depth: Rounded rectangles with soft shadows; the Transformer as layers of small blue ellipses fully connected by thin lines; region inputs as photo crops with thick coloured borders (red, blue, green, purple); the alignment output as a small blue heat-map grid; gradient-filled block arrows.
proposed_highlight: The model name sits as a large bold title above the main box, and the four pre-training tasks are named in bold under their mini-diagrams; colour-bordered region crops are re-used identically in every task panel so the inputs are recognisable.
lesson: Draw the shared model once large, then fan wide arrows to small copies of it, one per training objective, each showing only what that objective masks or predicts.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; remembered venue ECCV 2020 (not verified in this session).

arrangement.units: top: one large grey rounded box (the model) flanked by two framed embedder callouts; bottom: three identical grey 'UNITER' bars side by side, one per pre-training task, titled beneath in bold
arrangement.inputs_as: a row of real image-region crops with coloured borders followed by plain words, inside the model box and again under each task bar
arrangement.losses_at: each task's target sits above its own bar: the predicted word 'dog' (MLM), the recovered region crop (MRM), and a word-region heat map plus a 0/1 output (WRA + ITM)
arrangement.shared: the same model is redrawn as a small 'UNITER' bar in every task panel, fed by wide arrows from the large model

taxonomy.task: single-stream image-text pretraining with four objectives

core.what: one large grey 'UNITER Model' box with a transformer mesh over a row of region crops and words, from which three wide gradient arrows fan down to three small UNITER copies, one per pre-training task

relations.form: framed callouts at top-left (Image Embedder: R-CNN + Location -> FC -> + -> LN) and top-right (Text Embedder: Token + Position -> Emb -> + -> LN) tied to the input columns by dashed lines in their own tint
the transformer is drawn as a dense node-link mesh above one input column per region crop and per word

three bottom panels in a row (MLM, MRM, WRA+ITM), each the same grey UNITER bar over the same colour-bordered crops and words, differing only in what is masked ([MASK] word, hatched region) and what is predicted above (dog, a region crop, a word-region alignment matrix with a 0/1 output)
in the WRA panel a blue-shaded grid with regions and words as axes sits above the UNITER bar, fed by thin lines from the tokens

channels.colour: yellow tint = image side (image embedder, image-token columns), green tint = text side (text embedder, word columns); each region crop has its own coloured border (red, blue, green, purple) that identifies the same region across all panels; blue shade in the alignment grid = alignment strength
channels.shape: grey rounded bars are the model, small rectangles are layers, real crops and words are the inputs
channels.line: wide translucent blue arrows = 'same model, different task'; thin grey arrows = token flow; dashed lines tie callouts
channels.frame: rounded frames for the two embedder callouts and for each UNITER instance

quality.strengths: The shared model is drawn once large and reused as identical small bars, so the tasks differ only by their mask and prediction; real image regions and words are the inputs and keep their coloured borders across panels; the embedders are zoomed beside the inputs they produce.
quality.weaknesses: The big transformer mesh is decorative and carries no information about attention; the WRA+ITM panel overloads one bar with two objectives and the alignment matrix; ITM's 0/1 output is a tiny label easy to miss.

insights.structure: The single-stream model is one large grey rounded box across the top, its two embedders pulled out as zoom callouts in the top corners, and three small copies of the model sit side by side underneath for the pre-training tasks.
insights.data: Image regions are real photo crops each with a distinct thick coloured border, and the same bordered crops appear in every task panel; masked words show as [MASK] and a masked region as a hatched tile.
insights.emphasis: Three wide translucent blue arrows fan from the big model down to the task panels, and each task's bold name is written under its own panel.
insights.flow: The eye starts at the large 'UNITER Model' title, moves down through the Transformer to its inputs, then follows the fanned arrows to the three task panels at the bottom, read left to right.
insights.avoid: The Transformer is drawn as a dense mesh of fully connected ellipses that adds texture but no information, and its small row of yellow/green placeholder blocks repeats what the embedder callouts already show.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
